evidence_scope: User confirms portal batch success for two invoices; local application audit independently confirms a successful Minvoice signing operation at the latest recorded signing time.
limitations: Application audit records signing only; no batch invoice count, upload ACK or per-invoice issued state is stored in this audit record.
No signed XML or HTTP upload capture acquired from this macOS transaction.
App currently running was restarted after the recorded signing event; current in-memory UI cannot establish the prior batch result.
This confirms a user-reported two-invoice batch, not a live 300-invoice or multi-group batch.
Earlier -1003 configuration DNS failure root cause is not established by this later success.
